systematic.pattern: Mulligan decisions are inverted: Jev prefers to keep land-light hands and to mulligan land-rich ones.
systematic.count_or_examples: Pods 04-06: in all 4 hands Forge wanted to mulligan, Jev overruled to keep (pod04-g4 1 land p_keep=0.91; pod05-g3 1 land 0.85; pod06-g2 0 lands 0.79; pod05-g4 0 lands 0.68). Jev overruled Forge's keep to mulligan on 2 hands with 3 and 4 lands (pod04-g4 hand 1: Tropical, Swamp, Marsh Flats + Three Visits, p_keep=0.32; pod06-g4 hand 1: 4 lands, 0.25), and leaned to mulligan a third, gated (pod06-g4 hand 2: 4 lands + Sol Ring, 0.49). Across all 6 pods (29 mulligan decisions), Jev preferred to keep all 7 hands with 0-1 lands (6 overruled, 1 gated), and all 4 of its mulligan overrules were on 3-5-land hands. P(keep) by land count: 0 lands 0.55-0.79; 1 land 0.77-0.91; 4-5 lands 0.08-0.81. The memo is '' at every mulligan, and the prompt has no land count.
systematic.why_it_matters: 3 game-losing and 2 major reviewer mistakes (4 keeps plus a follow-on) trace to this, and it is the largest single cause in these pods. Two reviews (pod04-g4, pod06-g2) wrongly blamed Forge for the keep. A land-count guard or leaving mulligans to Forge would remove the failure.

systematic.pattern: Forge spends mana at instant speed in our own upkeep, and Jev always accepts.
systematic.count_or_examples: 10 own-upkeep decisions with a non-pass Forge default; Jev agreed with all 10 (0 gated, 0 overruled). 4 fed flagged mistakes: pod06-g1 t13 Capsule (the memo's Deluge X=4 became unaffordable and was never listed in MAIN1); pod06-g1 t25 Heroic Intervention with nothing to protect (5 mana down to 3, so Muldrotha was not offerable); pod05-g3 t13 Trophy on Topiary Stomper (all 3 mana gone before the main phase, so Birds could not be cast); pod06-g3 t37 Capsule on Cankerbloom (fed P4's Cordial Vampire and Patron). The others were Wayfarer's Bauble x2, Ratchet Bomb ticks x3, and Capsule at pod06-g3 t29.
systematic.why_it_matters: Sorcery-speed alternatives (Deluge, Muldrotha, creatures) are never in the upkeep option list, so neither Jev nor the memo can weigh them against the upkeep spend. Two reviewers described these as main-phase choices. Offering the upkeep window as 'pass by default' would stop it.

systematic.pattern: Forge makes resource-spending sub-choices silently: sacrifice and discard costs, the Gwen Stacy may-discard, shockland life payment, X values, mana tapping, and the commander-zone move.
systematic.count_or_examples: Braids end-step: 7 'Do you want to sacrifice?' confirms, all yes, and Forge picked the permanent: Swamp (pod04-g2 t37), Sol Ring (pod04-g2 t40), Island (pod05-g4 t37), Forest (pod06-g1 t25), Cryogen Relic x2, Servo, so 4 of 7 were mana sources while we were short of Muldrotha. Grist -2 sacrifice picked 3 times (including Lamia against the memo). Survival's discard (Doc Aurlock, not the memo's Kokusho). Concoction's discard and mill (Shriekmaw, Demonic Tutor). Claws sacrificed itself. Gwen Stacy II 'discard or lose 3' was chosen as discard 3 of 3 times. Shocklands entered tapped every time the mana count shows it (pod04-g3 t21, pod05-g2 t34, pod05-g2 t37, pod06-g4 t21, the last costing the 8th mana for Muldrotha). Toxic Deluge resolved at X=0 both times it was cast (pod06-g1 t17, pod06-g4 t49), each time after Jev overruled Forge's pass. Mana tapping at pod04-g2 t37 used both blue sources, making Glen's counter unpayable on t39. Kaya's Ghostform fizzled 2 of 2 times because Muldrotha went to the command zone (pod05-g1 t22, pod06-g4 t28).
systematic.why_it_matters: These choices never reach Jev or the memo, and the option text rarely says what will be paid. Several turned a correct pilot choice into a loss, and 5 reviewer mistakes are directly unhooked.

systematic.pattern: Muldrotha options are duplicated, which splits Jev's probability mass and inflates gating.
systematic.count_or_examples: 87 of 772 answered questions contain duplicate options after normalising tags, including all 23 action questions with 11 or more options. Muldrotha from the command zone is listed 2-3 times. Each graveyard cast appears as '... by Muldrotha (Creature)' and '... by Muldrotha (Creature) by Muldrotha (Creature)'; evoke doubles it again (Shriekmaw x4). Gated rate by option count: 8% (2 options), 11% (3-5), 21% (6-10), 17% (11+); Jev's mean p on its pick falls from 0.79 to 0.34. 4 'overrules' were between identical duplicates, so no real change (pod04-g1 t24 Capsule, pod05-g2 t26 Forest, pod05-g2 t30 Shriekmaw evoke, pod06-g4 t25 Ghostform). Example: pod05-g1 t27, Forge's Muldrotha recast held p=0.08 on one of three identical copies when Jev overruled to Syr Konrad (game-losing).
systematic.why_it_matters: A fixed 0.15 margin is harder to clear when the same play is spread across 2-4 entries. Overrule statistics are also slightly inflated by no-op switches.

systematic.pattern: Forge passes in MAIN1 with every nonland play tagged CantPlayAi; Jev mostly accepts or is gated.
systematic.count_or_examples: 130 MAIN1 decisions with a Forge pass while plays existed; in 114 every nonland option was tagged CantPlayAi. Of those 114, Jev agreed 52 times, was gated 25 and overruled 37. In 10 further MAIN1 decisions Forge's default skipped an available land drop; Jev overruled all 10 to play the land.
systematic.why_it_matters: Forge casts almost everything in MAIN2, so pre-combat removal and sweepers depend on Jev beating a pass by 0.15. Gated MAIN1 passes preceded flagged mistakes at pod04-g1 t16, pod05-g2 t34 and pod06-g3 t9/t13.

systematic.pattern: Option labels omit the effect that matters.
systematic.count_or_examples: Twisted Embrace: 24 offers, 24 tagged CantPlayAi, and the label shows only the Aura host ('→ target: Siren Stormtamer [ours, 1/1]'), never the destroy target; it was cast once. Invasion of Innistrad: 48 offers, 48 tagged CantPlayAi or BadEtbEffects, label is just the name (no -13/-13); never cast. Binding the Old Gods: 14 offers, 10 tagged, name only; never cast. Gwen Stacy: 42 offers, 30 tagged, name only. Toxic Deluge: no X. Attack options show only defender life, with no blockers (5 of 7 flagged attack mistakes). Blocks are asked per attacker with no total incoming damage. The window 'our main phase, stack empty' is identical in MAIN1 and MAIN2 (pod05-g3 t29 main-phase Fog). Glen's counter was offered while unpayable (pod04-g2 t39).
systematic.why_it_matters: The deck's premium answers (Embrace, Invasion, Binding) were never cast across 12 games, and 3 'no removal on the real threat' mistakes involve them. Jev cannot value a card whose label hides its effect.

systematic.pattern: Jev's hand-evaluation overrules discard mana and utility pieces.
systematic.count_or_examples: Discard overrule rate is 7/13 (54%) and mulligan 6/14 (43%), against 106/572 (19%) for action questions. In all 7 discard overrules Jev threw away a cheap mana or utility card (Farseek, Demonic Tutor, Survival, Mind Stone, Pernicious Deed, Birds of Paradise, Sol Ring) instead of Forge's pick (Vrock x4, Galactus, Secrets of the Dead, Swamp).
systematic.why_it_matters: It is consistent with the mulligan inversion: Jev appears to undervalue mana. 3 flagged mistakes (pod06-g2 t5, pod04-g2 t17, pod05-g4 t37), plus the Birds discard behind pod05-g3 t13.

systematic.pattern: The asymmetric pass margin (0.35) keeps Forge's play when Jev correctly wants to pass.
systematic.count_or_examples: 8 gated 2-option decisions where Forge wanted a play and Jev wanted to pass: pod06-g4 Syr Konrad self-mill x5 (t48, t51) while P3's Konrad punished creature cards hitting graveyards (part of the t51 mistake); Sakura-Tribe Elder x2 (pod06-g1); Wayfarer's Bauble (pod05-g4 t13). The reverse also happens: at pod06-g4 t36 Jev did overrule Forge's only untagged Survival activation to pass.
systematic.why_it_matters: It is small in count, but it directly produced part of a flagged endgame loss.

systematic.pattern: No evidence that activated abilities are missing from the options.
systematic.count_or_examples: Checked 35 of our permanents with activated abilities. Every case where an untapped permanent's activation was absent is explained by legality: Cabal Pit's threshold unmet (graveyard ≤6), Seal of Doom with only black targets, planeswalker once-per-turn, Stormtamer/Glen with nothing to target, summoning sickness. The only anomaly runs the other way: an unpayable Glen counter was offered (pod04-g2 t39).
systematic.why_it_matters: It rules out one hypothesised failure mode for these pods.
